  title: "How to Play WheelMates Split-Screen and Online Co-op",
  description: "Learn how to play WheelMates in local split-screen or online co-op mode. Discover how the Friend's Pass works for your partner to join for free.",

WheelMates offers a 2-player cooperative driving experience that centers around teamwork and puzzle-solving using remote-controlled (RC) cars. Players can enjoy the game together using either local split-screen or online co-op modes, making it an accessible title for couch co-op enthusiasts and long-distance friends alike.

## Setting Up Local Split-Screen

To play WheelMates in local split-screen mode, navigate to the main menu and select the local play option. Once the mode is selected, both players should ensure their controllers are properly connected to the PC.

Players will need to follow the on-screen prompts to confirm their participation. In the lobby, you can start a new game by pressing the designated button (typically "A" on standard gamepads). Once the game begins, the screen will divide to provide each player with their own view of the environment, allowing you to cooperate while navigating the various tracks found in Professor Bloom’s house.

## Online Co-op and the Friend's Pass

WheelMates features an online co-op mode that allows you to play with a friend, even if they do not own the game themselves. This is facilitated through the Friend’s Pass, which lets a second player join your session for free.

To set up an online session using the Friend’s Pass, follow these steps:

1. **Owner:** Launch the full version of WheelMates.
2. **Friend:** Download and launch the "WheelMates Friend’s Pass" version from the Steam store.
3. **Invite:** The owner must navigate to the Lobby, select PLAY, choose PLAY ONLINE, select HOST, and copy the provided invite code.
4. **Join:** The friend should select PLAY, choose FRIEND'S PASS, and enter the shared invite code to connect.
5. **Start:** Once connected, the host can begin the game.

## Tips for Cooperative Gameplay

WheelMates relies heavily on coordination. Much like other cooperative puzzle games, certain obstacles require two players to perform actions simultaneously. You may find yourself needing to press switches in different locations or timing jumps to progress through the environment.

The game features physics-based movement for the RC cars, which can feel erratic. Taking your time to maneuver through the "wasteland" sections or around tight corners is often more effective than attempting to accelerate at maximum speed, which can cause your vehicle to fly off the tracks. 

If you become stuck or fall into an abyss, the game generally provides a reset function. Be mindful of your surroundings, as some items, such as the green BH19 bipods, are highly conductive and will decommission your vehicle if you come into contact with them.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Does my friend need to buy WheelMates to play with me online?**
No, your friend does not need to purchase the game. They can download the WheelMates Friend’s Pass version and join your lobby for free using the invite code you provide.

**Can I play WheelMates by myself?**
WheelMates is designed as a 2-player cooperative adventure. While you are in the driver's seat, the puzzles and navigation are built around the necessity of two participants working together to overcome challenges.

**What should I do if I encounter a bug in the game?**
If you experience a bug, you should gather as much detail as possible about the issue, including a step-by-step description of what happened. Ensure you have the latest version of the game, which can be checked in the bottom-left corner of the main menu, before reporting the bug via the game's official community forums or Discord.
